svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 📮 A release that arrives tested / 🗺️ Set up with one command / 🌱 Nothing here ages silently / 🧩 Repos that fit together / 📦 Deciding the exception once / 💡 The intent obvious in the log / 🔔 Notify only when it is real / ⛓️ A gate that cannot drift / 🧹 Simplifying what people forget / 🔍 Metrics you can actually grep / 🧪 Gates that earn their runtime / 📉 One fewer step to remember

g.text: 💡 The intent obvious in the log
🔔 Notify only when it is real
